text.en:
Ravi's lunch box had only fried chips every day. By evening he felt tired and weak.
His teacher said, "Your body needs many kinds of food, not only one."
Next day his mother packed chapati, dal, a vegetable and a banana.

A balanced diet has all the nutrients our body needs in the right amounts: carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, fibre and water.
Cereals like rice and wheat give energy. Pulses, milk, eggs and fish help the body grow and repair. Fruits and vegetables give vitamins, minerals and fibre.
Eating too little causes weakness, and eating too much junk food or sugar can make us unwell. We should eat a variety of foods, drink enough water and eat on time.
A balanced diet has all the nutrients in the right amounts.
Rice and wheat give energy. Pulses, milk and eggs help us grow.
Fruits and vegetables give vitamins, minerals and fibre.
Eat a variety of food, drink water and avoid too much junk food.

problem.en: Ravi eats only chips. Which foods should he add to balance his meal?

text.en: Chips give mostly fat and salt.
He should add cereal for energy, dal or milk for growth, and fruit and vegetables for vitamins.

why.en: Each group gives a different nutrient.

text.en: Now his meal has many nutrients, so it is balanced.

prompt.en: A friend says eating only sweets is fine because they give energy. What will you say?

requiredIdeas.en: Sweets give energy but few other nutrients.
The body needs proteins, vitamins and minerals too.

commonMisconceptions.en: Thinking one kind of food is enough.

points.en: A balanced diet has all nutrients in the right amount.
Eat cereals, pulses, fruits, vegetables and drink water.
Too much junk food is not good.
